line.comment: * Job completion is automatically done by the vanilla game.
* Expanded 2.2: Deprecated taxi pay and reputation multipliers.
* Taxi earning potential scales with reputation, reaching its maximum at rank 7.
* Taxi jobs do not give reputation; Improved Taxis receive double payment.
* Make sure we're still docked at the station that triggered this run.
* Expanded 2.2: Initialize taxi passenger array. Cleaned up when the player joins the OCV.
* Remove Taxi passengers that no longer exist.
* Taxi jobs are available only at factories and trading stations.

* Pirates are excluded because they're too far.

line.text: 'This station does not offer Taxi jobs.'

line.comment: * Treat player-owned and company stations (always owned by Private Corp.) as reputation rank 4 (mid-tier offer).

line.text: 'Your reputation with this faction is too low.'

line.comment: * Expanded 2.2: Passenger availability scales with reputation.
* Starts at 1 passenger and increases at ranks 4 and 7, up to 3 passengers at rank 7.
* Starts at 1 jump and increases at ranks 4 and 7, up to 3 jumps at rank 7.

line.text: 'No valid passenger destination is currently available.'

line.comment: * Expanded 2.2: Destination is predetermined per station to prevent savescumming.
* Destination must still be eligible for Taxi jobs.
* Cannot return to the origin station.
* Normal faction Taxi jobs remain within the origin faction.
* Player and Private Corp stations may send passengers to supported factions.

line.text: 'The passenger destination is controlled by a hostile faction.'

line.comment: * Validate current docking eligibility using the actual Taxi.

line.text: 'Your Taxi cannot currently dock at the passenger destination.'

line.comment: * The predetermined destination must be within the range currently unlocked by the player's reputation.

line.text: 'The passenger destination is beyond your current Taxi range.'

line.comment: * Expanded 2.2: Base payment increased (1.5k-2k -> 3k).
* It is fixed at 3k per distance multiplier.
* Expanded 2.2 Reputation reward removed because successful passenger delivery cannot be verified
* and passengers can be disposed of elsewhere (e.g., enslaved at Pirate Bases).
* Ideally, the reputation reward would be given upon confirming that the passenger is transported, but there isn't a command to verify that.
* Consume the current Taxi offer. Cooldown timer increased from 30-60min to 1 hour.
* Predetermine the next destination immediately.
